name: golfapalooza-alexa-lambda
description: AWS Lambda function backing the Golfapalooza Alexa skill.

scripts.package: npm run build && (cd dist && zip -q -r ../function.zip index.js index.js.map)
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name golfapalooza-alexa --zip-file fileb://function.zip --region us-east-1
